# Frozen novelty statement

## Philosophical contribution

The paper replaces generic claims of representational plurality with a
property-relative criterion of establishment: the same transformation can be
faithful for gauge-invariant expectations, destructive of manifest locality,
and silent about spectrum.  Physical objectivity is tied to certified
recovery, not to invariance under every descriptive change.

## Formal contribution

It defines heterogeneous certificate profiles and indexed recovery systems,
proves their typed composition law, and proves a uniform
recovery-to-spectrum theorem on a dense centered core.  Exact countermodels
show why observable completeness, uniform physical rates, and limit order are
independent obligations.  The positive spectral lemma itself is standard;
no novelty claim is made for that ingredient in isolation.

## Methodological contribution

A single Yang--Mills chain exposes four distinct failures—quantifier-domain
overreach, boundary-state erasure, history erasure, and loss of normalization—
and associates each with a different repair.  The calculus therefore changes
the design of proof states and theorem ledgers rather than merely redescribing
them.

## Search qualification

The primary-source search found neighboring accounts of structural realism,
gauge surplus structure, theoretical equivalence, duality, functorial QFT,
perspicuous representation, and RG/EFT epistemology, but no identical
integrated proposal.  The paper uses “we develop” rather than “we are the
first,” and requires a final subscription-index search before submission.
